title: Redundant Iteration Roundtrips (Double Collecting)
pattern: Collecting an iterator into a collection (`Vec`, `HashSet`, etc.) only to immediately call `.into_iter()` on it again to chain more operations.
why_bad: Forces expensive heap allocations, data copying, and memory management overhead to build a temporary collection that is immediately discarded.
detection: An iterator chain containing `.collect()` immediately followed by variable binding and subsequent `.into_iter()` on the same variable.
counterexample: Cases where intermediate collecting is required to resolve borrow checker lifetimes or execute specific side-effects.
fix: Chain the iterator operations directly, performing exactly one final `.collect()` at the end.
